Also includes automatic leveling jacks, fiberglass front cap, cabover sleeping, powered sky view shade in cab overhead, audible lane departure warning, pre-collision assist with automatic emergency braking and forward collision warning, adjustable accelerator and brake pedals, remote start, SYNC 4 enhanced voice recognition communications and entertainment system, matte black wheels, keyless cab entry, valve stem extenders, fiberglass running boards, full extension soft close metal ball-bearing drawer guides, residential refrigerator, power vent in kitchen, solid surface kitchen countertops, wireless phone charger, Smart TV’s throughout the RV, Winegard ConnecT, exterior kitchen, solar, tankless water heater, heat pads on the holding tanks and much more.
